title: Install Unreal Engine
description: Download and install Unreal Engine 5 via the Epic Games Launcher.
problemStatement:
**Goal:** Set up Unreal Engine on your computer.

1. If you don’t have an Epic Games account, create one at [unrealengine.com](https://www.unrealengine.com).
2. Download and install the Epic Games Launcher.
3. Log in, navigate to the **Unreal Engine** tab, then **Library**.
4. Click the **+** icon next to **Engine Versions** and select the latest Unreal Engine 5.x version.
5. Choose your installation options (keep defaults) and click **Install**.
6. Wait for the download to finish (~40 GB).

**Check:** After installation, you should see a **Launch** button next to the engine version.
hints: Make sure you have enough free disk space (at least 40 GB).
An SSD is highly recommended for faster loading times.
expectedOutput: Unreal Engine 5.x installed and ready to launch from the Epic Games Launcher.
solutionCode: N/A – this is a manual installation task.
